articles.title: CJP's Das, Ranka try to sneak into Jantar Mantar, detained by Delhi Police
articles.description: Members of the Cockroach Janta Party gathered at Jantar Mantar carrying the national flag. They aimed to protest against the current government led by Narendramodi. Abhijeet Dipke reported on social media that certain individuals, including Ashutosh Ranka, were detained. The police intervened and took party members into custody during the protest. This situation highlights ongoing tensions between the party and government authorities over resistance movements.

articles.description: Parwinder Singh Jhota was involved in a sting operation targeting a medical store in Mansa. He confronted the store owner about selling prohibited substances and had a heated exchange before being shot. Despite his attempts to escape, Jhota fell and was pronounced dead at the hospital. The police have identified the shooter, Ashwani Kumar, who fled after the incident.

articles.title: Dad sold apartment, quit job; mom pledged gold: Making of India's latest WGM Sahithi
articles.description: Sahithi Varshini Moogi’s journey to becoming India’s latest Woman Grandmaster is a story of many elements, with talent, sacrifice, and perseverance only part of it. Despite losing nearly three years to the pandemic and facing financial hardships and limited opportunities, she achieved the milestone with her father, Lokeswara Moogi Rao, as her coach. After selling property, pledging gold, and quitting his job, he continues pursuing her dream of chess greatness.

articles.title: Michael Dell-backed firm’s $875 million Boca Raton resort bet draws luxury homebuyers; 40% of first 75 condos claimed
articles.description: An impressive $875 million investment is set to transform The Boca Raton resort into a luxurious haven of residential condominiums. With around 40% of these high-end residences already reserved, pricing starts at $8.95 million and can exceed $20 million. This revitalization forms part of the resort's centennial celebrations scheduled for 2026, with construction commencing the same year and concluding by 2029.

articles.title: New Yorkers queue for hours to buy subway memorabilia, with signs costing over $1,000
articles.description: New Yorkers queued for hours at an annual MTA sale in south Brooklyn to buy discarded subway signs, seats and MetroCards. Station signs cost $500 to over $1,000, while orange subway seats sold for around $900. Filmmaker Spike Lee was among the shoppers, purchasing a Penn Station sign. The two-day event attracts around 4,000 visitors annually.

articles.title: Opal Tower cracks forced Christmas Eve evacuation in 2018; eight years later, it is defect-free
articles.description: After nearly eight years of uncertainty, Sydney's Opal Tower has officially been declared defect-free, following significant structural issues uncovered in December 2018. This crisis led to evacuations, extensive repairs, and legal conflicts regarding the building's safety standards. Most residents have safely returned after comprehensive rectification processes, and property owners will receive compensation along with a 20-year structural warranty.

articles.title: 14-year-old Indonesian plants 38,000 mangroves, helps local women turn them into sustainable products
articles.description: In Indonesia, young activist Harley Fatahillah Yodhaloka Sunoto is leading a passionate campaign for mangrove restoration and climate education. Through his Mangrove Warrior initiative, he has successfully planted thousands of seedlings in critical coastal regions, strengthening ecosystems and supporting local communities. By collaborating with mothers and organizations, Harley is educating on sustainable practices, with an ambitious goal of planting one million mangroves and launching educational programs nationwide.

articles.title: Five Indiana engineering students built a 12-hour wearable that helps visually impaired users detect obstacles beyond a cane or guide dog
articles.description: Rose-Hulman students have developed a remarkable wearable device tailored for visually impaired individuals. This innovative headgear employs advanced sensors to identify surrounding obstacles, providing users with haptic feedback. With a remarkable twelve-hour battery life on a single charge, this device empowers users with greater independence. The project's goal is to enhance the day-to-day experiences of those with vision impairments.

articles.title: 'Ramayana' makers unveil Jatayu poster featuring Anupam Kher
articles.description: The character poster for 'Ramayana' introduces Jatayu, a mythical bird that embodies valor and duty. Anupam Kher, a seasoned actor, provides the voice for this pivotal figure. Jatayu’s presence emphasizes the saga’s core messages of courage and moral integrity against malevolence. Directed by Nitesh Tiwari, this adaptation is set to unfold in two parts, beginning in 2026, aiming to connect the timeless tale with today’s audience.
